summary: Frontend-only pre-publish regression for Fork·Fate PWA. Verified home load, guided-intro skip, __ffFateBusy toggle, all 10 themes render without React errors, and all 6 realm heists (ghost/snowman/owl/petal/neon/steam) mount their DOM testids and restore the header logo on time. Trophy Shelf on /rituals seeded correctly (2/16, snatch+owl unlocked, rest locked), heists-grid renders 16 cards, and /bingo loads cleanly. All 16 audio + 7 sprite assets return HTTP 200. No console errors, no page errors, no red React overlays on Home, /rituals, /bingo.
critical_code_review_comments: petal-coral.png still returns HTTP 200 (not 404) — asset file appears to still exist in /app/frontend/public even though it is no longer referenced by spring ambient code. Not a bug, but the review request suggests it was 'deleted'. Consider actually removing the file to reduce bundle/public size if it is truly unused.

The reveal-guard behavior verified: window.__ffFateBusy=true while guided intro overlay is open (including the theme-welcome overlay on first-visit), and becomes false after guided-skip. Working as documented.
seed_data_creation: localStorage seeded per-test: ff_muted='1', ff_theme_chosen='1', ff_theme_hint_seen='1', ff_theme=<theme>, and ff_heists_seen={snatch:{count:1},owl:{count:2}} for Trophy Shelf verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Detailed matrix — Themes rendered clean: dark, winter, fall, spring, summer, steam, cyber, fairy, fantasy, tiki. Heists: ghost-snatch-heist + ghost-snatch-logo mount on 'ff:ghost-heist' (dark), reaper-companion present, logo opacity=1 by ~8s. snowman-heist mounts + snowman-head-wink observed during sit phase (winter), logo restored. owl-heist mounts on 'ff:owl-heist' (fall); owl-heist-logo clone appears ~1.5s after dispatch (needs polling, not immediate query). petal-heist mounts (spring), petal-heist-logo clone appears ~1.2s later; ambient img srcs only reference /petal-pink.png (no petal-coral). neon-crash: car mounts, sparks visible ~2.5s, cyber-neon-sign opacity drops to ~0.22 during crash and returns to 1 by ~8s. steam-logo-gear present with inner div transform matrix advancing over 1.2s (ticking confirmed). steam-logo-burst mounts on 'ff:steam-burst' and unmounts by ~3s. Trophy Shelf: [data-testid=heist-trophy-shelf], [data-testid=trophy-count] reads '2 / 16', [data-testid=trophy-icon-snatch] and [data-testid=trophy-icon-owl] present, [data-testid=heists-grid] has 16 children, only the 2 seeded (×1, ×2) lack Lock icons. Audio + sprite HEAD checks all 200. /bingo loads with cuisine grid, no errors.
